current_prompt.body:
DEFINE a comparison-based sorting algorithm
CONSTRAIN the algorithm to run in O(n) worst-case time complexity
ENSURE the algorithm is stable, preserving the relative order of equal elements
REQUIRE the algorithm to sort in-place using O(1) additional space

current_plan.body:

IDENTIFY theoretical possibilities for linear‑time comparison sorts under the given constraints
DESIGN a high‑level algorithmic approach that satisfies all constraints without committing to a specific implementation detail
VALIDATE that the designed approach preserves the relative order of equal elements (stability)
VALIDATE that the approach operates within O(1) additional memory (in‑place)
